raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Branch: mick/wan-fused-qk-norm-rope (on main 1e894eb92d), commit 75cc4e726b

## Motivation

Wan normalizes q and k across all heads (`qk_norm="rms_norm_across_heads"`) with FlashInfer's RMSNorm and then rotates them with FlashInfer's interleaved cos/sin-cache RoPE: three full passes over q and k in every block. On Wan2.2 A14B 720p (4xB300, 37800 x 5120 tokens per rank) they take 0.54 ms of each 55 ms block inside the denoising loop (RMSNorm 0.144 ms x 2, RoPE 0.255 ms, at the power-capped clock).

## Modifications

- `kernels/ops/diffusion/rope/rmsnorm_interleaved_rope_cutedsl.py`: `fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope_(x, weight, cos_sin_cache, eps, head_dim)`, in place on `x [M, H]` (row stride free). The norm part is FlashInfer's CuTe-DSL `RMSNormKernel` (single-CTA rows, same tiling, `row_reduce_sum_multirow`, fastmath rsqrt), so its bf16 output matches `flashinfer.norm.rmsnorm`; the store then rotates each (even, odd) pair of that bf16 output in fp32 with the RoPE kernel's expression (`a*c + (-b)*s`, `b*c + a*s`, row `m` at position `m % len(cache)`). Each thread's 8-column runs sit one head-multiple apart, so one 4-pair cos/sin slice (two 16-byte loads) serves all of them. `can_use_fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope` states the supported inputs; the kernel runs on torch's current stream.
- `models/dits/wanvideo.py`: `WanTransformerBlock._qkv_rope` projects q/k/v and, when the q/k norm runs FlashInfer's kernel (`forward_cuda`, no TP across heads) and the transformer supplies its cos/sin cache, applies the fused pass to q and k and tells `forward` to skip the RoPE. `_qkv` (used by Wan-Animate) keeps its behaviour.

## Accuracy Tests

- `test_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope.py`:
  - bitwise equal to `flashinfer.norm.rmsnorm` + `apply_flashinfer_rope_qk_inplace` (5120 / 3072 hidden, batch 1-2, rows padded apart as in a fused projection);
  - inputs produced on a side stream right before the call (it must run on torch's current stream);
  - a full Wan block (5120, 40 heads) gives the same bits with the fusion on and off;
  - unsupported inputs are rejected.
- Wan2.2 T2V A14B 720p, 4xB300, 3-step requests, lossless (crf 0) mp4: md5 identical to the base for 3 prompts.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

B300, q and k `[37800, 5120]` bf16, each call between 5120x5120 GEMMs at the power cap (median):

| | RMSNorm q | RMSNorm k | RoPE q+k | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before | 0.144 ms | 0.144 ms | 0.255 ms | 0.542 ms |
| fused | 0.171 ms | 0.171 ms | - | 0.342 ms |

E2E, Wan2.2 T2V A14B 720p (81 frames, 40 steps), 4xB300, harness single_e2e (fresh server per run, runs interleaved with the base): this PR together with #46227 ("Walk several row chunks per warp in the CuTe-DSL norm kernels") took the request from 90.656 s (90.642 / 90.671) to 90.187 s (90.160 / 90.214), -0.47 s. The two changes were checked bitwise separately but timed together.

nodes.body:
This breaks the diffusion tests on AMD. `wanvideo.py` now imports `can_use_fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope` / `fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope_` at module level, which loads `rmsnorm_interleaved_rope_cutedsl.py` and its `import cuda.bindings.driver`. ROCm has no cuda-python, so importing `wanvideo` fails:

```
File ".../models/dits/wanvideo.py", line 12, in <module>
  from sglang.kernels.ops.diffusion import (
File ".../kernels/ops/diffusion/rope/rmsnorm_interleaved_rope_cutedsl.py", line 11, in <module>
  import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'cuda'
```

`longlive2_t2v` and `wan2_2_animate_2_14b_distilled_ref2v` fail at server startup on main: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40147750783/job/121032677999 (Wan T2V cases only pass there because the loader falls back to the diffusers transformer).

Fix that imports the two names inside the fused branch instead: #46396

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,317 @@
+"""RMSNorm over the whole hidden size followed by interleaved RoPE, in one pass.
+
+Wan's self-attention normalizes q and k across all heads (``rms_norm_across_heads``)
+and then rotates (even, odd) pairs of every head. The norm pass below is FlashInfer's
+CuTe-DSL ``RMSNormKernel`` (single-CTA rows), with the same tiling and reduction, so
+its bf16 output matches ``flashinfer.norm.rmsnorm``; the store then applies the
+interleaved rotation of FlashInfer's ``BatchQKApplyRotaryPosIdsCosSinCache`` kernel
+(``cos_sin_cache`` row = position, cos then sin) to that bf16 output in fp32.
+"""
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import torch
+from cutlass import Float32, Int64
+from flashinfer.norm.utils import (
+    COPY_BITS,
+    predicate_k,
+    row_reduce_sum_multirow,
+)
+
+_COMPILE_CACHE = {}
+_TORCH_TO_CUTE = {torch.bfloat16: cutlass.BFloat16, torch.float16: cutlass.Float16}
+
+
+def _threads_per_row(H: int) -> int:
+    # FlashInfer RMSNormKernel._compute_threads_per_row
+    if H <= 64:
+        return 8
+    if H <= 128:
+        return 16
+    if H <= 3072:
+        return 32
+    if H <= 6144:
+        return 64
+    if H <= 16384:
+        return 128
+    return 256
+
+
+class RMSNormInterleavedRope:
+    def __init__(self, dtype: cutlass.Numeric, H: int, head_dim: int):
+        self.dtype = dtype
+        self.H = H
+        self.head_dim = head_dim
+        elem_bytes = dtype.width // 8
+        self.vec_size = min(H & (-H), COPY_BITS // 8 // elem_bytes)
+        self.copy_bits = self.vec_size * dtype.width
+        self.threads_per_row = _threads_per_row(H)
+        self.num_threads = 128 if H <= 16384 else 256
+        self.rows_per_block = self.num_threads // self.threads_per_row
+        self.warps_per_row = max(self.threads_per_row // 32, 1)
+        self.num_vec_blocks = max(
+            1,
+            (H // self.vec_size + self.threads_per_row - 1) // self.threads_per_row,
+        )
+        self.cols_per_tile = self.vec_size * self.num_vec_blocks * self.threads_per_row
+        tile_bytes = self.rows_per_block * self.cols_per_tile * elem_bytes
+        props = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(torch.cuda.current_device())
+        self.use_async_copy = tile_bytes <= props.shared_memory_per_block_optin // 2
+
+    def _smem_size_in_bytes(self) -> int:
+        tile_bytes = (
+            self.rows_per_block * self.cols_per_tile * (self.dtype.width // 8)
+            if self.use_async_copy
+            else 0
+        )
+        return tile_bytes + self.rows_per_block * self.warps_per_row * 4
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        mX: cute.Tensor,
+        mW: cute.Tensor,
+        mY: cute.Tensor,
+        mCS: cute.Tensor,
+        M: Int64,
+        seq_len: Int64,
+        eps: Float32,
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ):
+        tv_shape = (
+            (self.threads_per_row, self.rows_per_block),
+            (self.vec_size, self.num_vec_blocks),
+        )
+        tv_stride = (
+            (self.vec_size * self.rows_per_block, 1),
+            (
+                self.rows_per_block,
+                self.rows_per_block * self.vec_size * self.threads_per_row,
+            ),
+        )
+        tv_layout = cute.make_layout(tv_shape, stride=tv_stride)
+        tiler_mn = (self.rows_per_block, self.cols_per_tile)
+        self.kernel(mX, mW, mY, mCS, M, seq_len, eps, tv_layout, tiler_mn).launch(
+            grid=[cute.ceil_div(M, self.rows_per_block), 1, 1],
+            block=[self.num_threads, 1, 1],
+            smem=self._smem_size_in_bytes(),
+            stream=stream,
+        )
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        mX: cute.Tensor,
+        mW: cute.Tensor,
+        mY: cute.Tensor,
+        mCS: cute.Tensor,
+        M: Int64,
+        seq_len: Int64,
+        eps: Float32,
+        tv_layout: cute.Layout,
+        tiler_mn: cute.Shape,
+    ):
+        tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        bidx, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        H = self.H
+        threads_per_row = tv_layout.shape[0][0]
+        rows_per_block = tiler_mn[0]
+        warps_per_row = max(threads_per_row // 32, 1)
+        half = self.head_dim // 2
+        pairs = self.vec_size // 2
+
+        smem = cutlass.utils.SmemAllocator()
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.use_async_copy):
+            sX = smem.allocate_tensor(
+                mX.element_type,
+                cute.make_ordered_layout(tiler_mn, order=(1, 0)),
+                byte_alignment=16,
+            )
+        reduction_buffer = smem.allocate_tensor(
+            Float32,
+            cute.make_layout((rows_per_block, warps_per_row)),
+            byte_alignment=4,
+        )
+
+        idX = cute.make_identity_tensor(mX.shape)
+        gX = cute.local_tile(mX, tiler_mn, (bidx, 0))
+        gY = cute.local_tile(mY, tiler_mn, (bidx, 0))
+        cX = cute.local_tile(idX, tiler_mn, (bidx, 0))
+        mW_2d = cute.make_tensor(
+            mW.iterator,
+            cute.prepend(mW.layout, cute.make_layout((tiler_mn[0],), stride=(0,))),
+        )
+        gW = cute.local_tile(mW_2d, tiler_mn, (0, 0))
+
+        copy_atom_sync = cute.make_copy_atom(
+            cute.nvgpu.CopyUniversalOp(),
+            mX.element_type,
+            num_bits_per_copy=self.copy_bits,
+        )
+        copy_atom_store = cute.make_copy_atom(
+            cute.nvgpu.CopyUniversalOp(),
+            mY.element_type,
+            num_bits_per_copy=self.copy_bits,
+        )
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.use_async_copy):
+            copy_atom_async = cute.make_copy_atom(
+                cute.nvgpu.cpasync.CopyG2SOp(),
+                mX.element_type,
+                num_bits_per_copy=self.copy_bits,
+            )
+            tiled_copy_load = cute.make_tiled_copy(copy_atom_async, tv_layout, tiler_mn)
+        else:
+            tiled_copy_load = cute.make_tiled_copy(copy_atom_sync, tv_layout, tiler_mn)
+        tiled_copy_W = cute.make_tiled_copy(copy_atom_sync, tv_layout, tiler_mn)
+        tiled_copy_store = cute.make_tiled_copy(copy_atom_store, tv_layout, tiler_mn)
+        thr_copy_X = tiled_copy_load.get_slice(tidx)
+        thr_copy_W = tiled_copy_W.get_slice(tidx)
+        thr_copy_O = tiled_copy_store.get_slice(tidx)
+
+        tXgX = thr_copy_X.partition_S(gX)
+        tXcX = thr_copy_X.partition_S(cX)
+        tXrX = cute.make_fragment_like(tXgX)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.use_async_copy):
+            tXsX = thr_copy_X.partition_D(sX)
+        tWgW = thr_copy_W.partition_S(gW)
+        tWrW = cute.make_fragment_like(tWgW)
+        tXrW = thr_copy_X.retile(tWrW)
+        tXgO = thr_copy_O.partition_D(gY)
+        tXrO = cute.make_fragment_like(tXgO)
+
+        tXpX = predicate_k(tXcX, limit=H)
+        tWpW = predicate_k(thr_copy_W.partition_S(cX), limit=H)
+        row_coord = tXcX[(0, 0), 0, 0]
+        row_in_bounds = row_coord[0] < M
+
+        # 1. load the row (and the weight)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.use_async_copy):
+            if row_in_bounds:
+                cute.copy(copy_atom_async, tXgX, tXsX, pred=tXpX)
+            cute.arch.cp_async_commit_group()
+            cute.copy(copy_atom_sync, tWgW, tWrW, pred=tWpW)
+            cute.arch.cp_async_wait_group(0)
+            cute.autovec_copy(tXsX, tXrX)
+        else:
+            tXrX.store(cute.zeros_like(tXrX, dtype=mX.element_type))
+            if row_in_bounds:
+                cute.copy(copy_atom_sync, tXgX, tXrX, pred=tXpX)
+            cute.copy(copy_atom_sync, tWgW, tWrW, pred=tWpW)
+
+        # this thread's 8-column runs sit at the same offset of every head (the runs are
+        # one head-multiple apart), so one 4-pair cos / sin slice serves all of them
+        pair0 = (tXcX[(0, 0), 0, 0][1] % self.head_dim) // 2
+        tCS = cute.make_rmem_tensor(cute.make_layout((self.vec_size,)), Float32)
+        tCS.fill(0.0)
+        if row_in_bounds:
+            pos = Int64(row_coord[0]) % seq_len
+            gC = cute.local_tile(mCS, (1, pairs), (pos, pair0 // pairs))
+            gS = cute.local_tile(mCS, (1, pairs), (pos, (half + pair0) // pairs))
+            tC = cute.make_rmem_tensor(cute.make_layout((1, pairs)), Float32)
+            tS = cute.make_rmem_tensor(cute.make_layout((1, pairs)), Float32)
+            cute.autovec_copy(gC, tC)
+            cute.autovec_copy(gS, tS)
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(pairs):
+                tCS[i] = tC[0, i]
+                tCS[pairs + i] = tS[0, i]
+
+        # 2. RMSNorm, as FlashInfer's RMSNormKernel
+        x = tXrX.load().to(Float32)
+        x_sq = x * x
+        sum_sq = row_reduce_sum_multirow(
+            x_sq, threads_per_row, reduction_buffer, None, 1
+        )
+        mean_sq = sum_sq / Float32(H)
+        rstd = cute.math.rsqrt(mean_sq + eps, fastmath=True)
+        cute.arch.barrier()
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.use_async_copy):
+            cute.autovec_copy(tXsX, tXrX)
+            x = tXrX.load().to(Float32)
+        w = tXrW.load().to(Float32)
+        y = x * rstd * (w + Float32(0.0))
+        tXrO.store(y.to(mY.element_type))
+
+        # 3. rotate each (even, odd) pair of the rounded output in fp32
+        for blk in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.num_vec_blocks):
+            for v in cutlass.range_constexpr(0, self.vec_size, 2):
+                a = tXrO[(v, blk), 0, 0].to(Float32)
+                b = tXrO[(v + 1, blk), 0, 0].to(Float32)
+                c = tCS[v // 2]
+                s = tCS[pairs + v // 2]
+                tXrO[(v, blk), 0, 0] = (a * c + (-b) * s).to(mY.element_type)
+                tXrO[(v + 1, blk), 0, 0] = (b * c + a * s).to(mY.element_type)
+
+        if row_in_bounds:
+            cute.copy(copy_atom_store, tXrO, tXgO, pred=tXpX)
+
+
+def can_use_fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    head_dim: int,
+) -> bool:
+    """Whether ``fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope_`` takes ``x`` [M, H]."""
+    H = x.shape[-1]
+    return (
+        x.is_cuda
+        and x.dim() == 2
+        and x.dtype in _TORCH_TO_CUTE
+        and weight.dtype == x.dtype
+        and weight.shape == (H,)
+        and weight.is_contiguous()
+        and x.stride(-1) == 1
+        and x.stride(0) % 8 == 0
+        and x.data_ptr() % 16 == 0
+        and H % 8 == 0
+        and H <= 6144
+        and (_threads_per_row(H) * 8) % head_dim == 0
+        and cos_sin_cache.dtype == torch.float32
+        and cos_sin_cache.dim() == 2
+        and cos_sin_cache.shape[-1] == head_dim
+        and cos_sin_cache.is_contiguous()
+        and x.shape[0] % cos_sin_cache.shape[0] == 0
+    )
+
+
+def fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope_(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    head_dim: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """In place: x [M, H] <- RoPE(RMSNorm(x) * weight), row m at position m % len(cos_sin_cache).
+
+    ``cos_sin_cache`` is [seq_len, head_dim] fp32 (cos | sin of each pair); bit-identical
+    to ``flashinfer.norm.rmsnorm`` then FlashInfer's interleaved cos/sin-cache RoPE.
+    """
+    M, H = x.shape
+    key = (x.dtype, H, head_dim)
+    compiled = _COMPILE_CACHE.get(key)
+    if compiled is None:
+        dtype = _TORCH_TO_CUTE[x.dtype]
+        sym_m = cute.sym_int(64)
+        x_fake = cute.runtime.make_fake_tensor(
+            dtype, (sym_m, H), (cute.sym_int64(divisibility=8), 1), assumed_align=16
+        )
+        w_fake = cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(dtype, (H,), assumed_align=16)
+        cs_fake = cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(
+            Float32, (cute.sym_int(64), head_dim), stride_order=(1, 0), assumed_align=16
+        )
+        compiled = _COMPILE_CACHE[key] = cute.compile(
+            RMSNormInterleavedRope(dtype, H, head_dim),
+            x_fake,
+            w_fake,
+            x_fake,
+            cs_fake,
+            Int64(1),
+            Int64(1),
+            Float32(1e-6),
+            cuda.CUstream(cuda.CUstream_flags.CU_STREAM_DEFAULT),
+            options="--enable-tvm-ffi",
+        )
+    stream = cuda.CUstream(torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream)
+    compiled(x, weight, x, cos_sin_cache, M, cos_sin_cache.shape[0], eps, stream)
+    return x

@@ -13,8 +13,10 @@
     FUSED_LINEAR_GELU,
     NVFP4_BIAS_GELU,
     BitExactFusionGate,
+    can_use_fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope,
     can_use_linear_gelu,
     fused_linear_gelu_tanh,
+    fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope_,
     fused_temb_table_slices,

+"""``fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope_``: Wan's across-heads q/k RMSNorm and its
+interleaved RoPE in one pass, held bit-exact to the two kernels it replaces
+(``flashinfer.norm.rmsnorm`` then FlashInfer's interleaved cos/sin-cache RoPE)."""
+
+import sys
+from contextlib import ExitStack
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from flashinfer.norm import rmsnorm
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.diffusion import (
+    can_use_fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope,
+    fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope_,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.distributed.parallel_state import (
+    maybe_init_distributed_environment_and_model_parallel,
+    model_parallel_is_initialized,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention import layer
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.sdpa import SDPABackend
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.rotary_embedding.utils import (
+    apply_flashinfer_rope_qk_inplace,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.managers.forward_context import set_forward_context
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits.wanvideo import WanTransformerBlock
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.test.single_test_file.component_accuracy.utils import (
+    ensure_distributed_env_defaults,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=30, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+
+def _require_sm90() -> None:
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available() or torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] < 9:
+        pytest.skip("CuTe-DSL RMSNorm needs sm_90+")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "batch,seq,hidden,head_dim,row_pad",
+    [
+        (1, 333, 5120, 128, 0),
+        (2, 150, 5120, 128, 0),
+        (1, 257, 3072, 128, 0),
+        (1, 64, 5120, 128, 1024),
+    ],
+)
+def test_matches_rmsnorm_then_rope_bitwise(batch, seq, hidden, head_dim, row_pad):
+    _require_sm90()
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seq * hidden + batch)
+    eps = 1e-6
+    x = (torch.randn(batch * seq, hidden, generator=g, device="cuda") * 3).bfloat16()
+    weight = (1 + 0.1 * torch.randn(hidden, generator=g, device="cuda")).bfloat16()
+    theta = torch.rand(seq, head_dim // 2, generator=g, device="cuda") * 100
+    cache = torch.cat([theta.cos(), theta.sin()], dim=-1).contiguous()
+
+    normed = rmsnorm(x, weight, eps).view(batch, seq, hidden // head_dim, head_dim)
+    ref, _ = apply_flashinfer_rope_qk_inplace(
+        normed, normed.clone(), cache, is_neox=False
+    )
+
+    # rows padded apart, as a slice of a wider projection output
+    buf = torch.full(
+        (batch * seq, hidden + row_pad), float("nan"), device="cuda"
+    ).bfloat16()
+    out = buf[:, :hidden]
+    out.copy_(x)
+    assert can_use_fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope(out, weight, cache, head_dim)
+    fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope_(out, weight, cache, eps, head_dim)
+    assert torch.equal(
+        out.view(torch.int16), ref.reshape(batch * seq, hidden).view(torch.int16)
+    )
+    if row_pad:
+        assert buf[:, hidden:].isnan().all()
+
+
+def test_runs_on_the_current_stream():
+    """Launched on torch's current stream: its input may still be in flight there."""
+    _require_sm90()
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(1)
+    eps, hidden, head_dim, rows = 1e-6, 5120, 128, 4096
+    a = torch.randn(rows, 1024, generator=g, device="cuda").bfloat16()
+    b = torch.randn(1024, hidden, generator=g, device="cuda").bfloat16()
+    weight = (1 + 0.1 * torch.randn(hidden, generator=g, device="cuda")).bfloat16()
+    theta = torch.rand(rows, head_dim // 2, generator=g, device="cuda")
+    cache = torch.cat([theta.cos(), theta.sin()], dim=-1).contiguous()
+    side = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    side.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    with torch.cuda.stream(side):
+        for _ in range(3):
+            x = a @ b
+            ref = rmsnorm(x, weight, eps).view(1, rows, hidden // head_dim, head_dim)
+            ref, _ = apply_flashinfer_rope_qk_inplace(
+                ref, ref.clone(), cache, is_neox=False
+            )
+            out = a @ b
+            fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope_(out, weight, cache, eps, head_dim)
+            assert torch.equal(
+                out.view(torch.int16), ref.reshape(rows, hidden).view(torch.int16)
+            )
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def test_wan_block_fused_qk_norm_rope_is_bit_exact():
+    """A Wan block gives the same bits with the q/k norm and RoPE fused or not."""
+    _require_sm90()
+    if not model_parallel_is_initialized():
+        ensure_distributed_env_defaults()
+        maybe_init_distributed_environment_and_model_parallel(tp_size=1, sp_size=1)
+    seq, dim, heads = 512, 5120, 40
+    with ExitStack() as stack:
+        for name, value in (
+            ("get_attn_backend", SDPABackend),
+            ("get_compute_dtype", torch.bfloat16),
+            ("_resolve_sp_attention_mode", ("ulysses", False)),
+            ("_maybe_install_backend_autotune", None),
+        ):
+            stack.enter_context(patch.object(layer, name, return_value=value))
+        stack.enter_context(set_forward_context(0, None))
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        block = WanTransformerBlock(
+            dim,
+            1024,
+            heads,
+            qk_norm="rms_norm_across_heads",
+            cross_attn_norm=True,
+            eps=1e-6,
+            supported_attention_backends=set(),
+        ).cuda()
+        for p in block.parameters():
+            p.normal_(0, 0.02)
+        block.norm_q.weight.normal_(1, 0.1)
+        block.norm_k.weight.normal_(1, 0.1)
+        block = block.to(torch.bfloat16)
+        assert block.fuse_qk_norm_rope
+        x = torch.randn(1, seq, dim, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        context = torch.randn(1, 64, dim, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        temb = torch.randn(1, 6, dim, device="cuda")
+        theta = torch.rand(seq, 64, device="cuda") * 50
+        cos, sin = theta.cos(), theta.sin()
+        cache = torch.cat([cos, sin], dim=-1).contiguous()
+        outs = []
+        for fuse in (False, True):
+            block.fuse_qk_norm_rope = fuse
+            outs.append(block(x, context, temb, (cos, sin), rope_cos_sin_cache=cache))
+    assert torch.equal(outs[0].view(torch.int16), outs[1].view(torch.int16))
+
+
+def test_rejects_unsupported_inputs():
+    _require_sm90()
+    x = torch.zeros(8, 5120, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    w = torch.ones(5120, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    cache = torch.zeros(8, 128, device="cuda")
+    assert can_use_fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope(x, w, cache, 128)
+    assert not can_use_fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope(x.float(), w.float(), cache, 128)
+    assert not can_use_fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope(x, w.float(), cache, 128)
+    assert not can_use_fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope(x, w, cache.bfloat16(), 128)
+    assert not can_use_fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope(x, w, cache[:3], 128)
+    assert not can_use_fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope(
+        x[:, 1:5113], w[:5112], cache, 128
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))

issue_comments.body:
This breaks the diffusion tests on AMD. `wanvideo.py` now imports `can_use_fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope` / `fused_rmsnorm_interleaved_rope_` at module level, which loads `rmsnorm_interleaved_rope_cutedsl.py` and its `import cuda.bindings.driver`. ROCm has no cuda-python, so importing `wanvideo` fails:

```
File ".../models/dits/wanvideo.py", line 12, in <module>
  from sglang.kernels.ops.diffusion import (
File ".../kernels/ops/diffusion/rope/rmsnorm_interleaved_rope_cutedsl.py", line 11, in <module>
  import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'cuda'
```

`longlive2_t2v` and `wan2_2_animate_2_14b_distilled_ref2v` fail at server startup on main: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40147750783/job/121032677999 (Wan T2V cases only pass there because the loader falls back to the diffusers transformer).

Fix that imports the two names inside the fused branch instead: #46396
